en.html:
After due consideration, Ichizo Sorimachi decided: kismat achhi thi. On the whole, rather lucky.

This conclusion he reached on a futon thin as papad, while his poor body supplied complaints from every department.

Escape from policeman, failed. Down a slope, into an autumn river, cold also. Haan, bad luck, he admitted. But picked up and treated before he froze to death? For a fellow like him, that was a windfall.

Zinda hai, toh lucky hai. Alive means lucky. Result ke saath behas kya? A man could not argue with the result, so lucky it was.

One worry only. Policeman or inspector barges in here, phir? Sorimachi, a man of the trade, thought something could be arranged.

Two helpless children in the house. Before he was pinned down, grab one as hostage. Rasta khul jaayega. A way out would open.

Thinking this gave him no pain. Sadistic pleasure also, no. Unless it put one over on that policeman or the GHQ woman... achha, then perhaps a little. No need to become excessively modest about the possible benefit.

This was Ichizo Sorimachi. Chhota aadmi, small nature. Small and low he had lived, small and low was satisfactory.

Hurt someone, trap someone, collect a little profit. There his brain worked beautifully. Chivalry, gratitude, loyalty, filial duty—these high-class matters, samajh hi nahin aata. No meaning reached him.

Then kya karein? Fine living he left to people who understood fine things. Ask a small fellow to carry such big principles, his back might break. Much more practical to let the other person carry them, then take advantage of how carefully he walked.

So no hesitation. Harm the girls who saved him? Thought did not trouble him. Action would not trouble him either. Thin smile on his face, Sorimachi could do it.

His meanness was no imitation. Forged right through. Mind fogged by bruises, still these plans kept arriving. The door opened; at once he turned to the next room and prepared. Alag hi level. A different class of low.

He made himself unnoticeable. Half out of his senses already, so half the work was done, he foolishly thought for one moment. Breath held, head toward the gap in the paper door.

And he looked into the next room.

ja.html:
雪車町一蔵は結論として、自分はまあそこそこ幸運
だったと、そう思うことにした。
　痛む体を、煎餅布団に横たえながら。

　あの<ruby>警官<rt>おまわり</rt></ruby>から逃げ損ね、斜面を転げ落ち秋の温かく
もない川に没する羽目になったのは不運としても。
　凍死する前に拾われ手当てを受けられたのは、自分
のような人間にとっては稀有の奇貨。

　そうして結果的に、自分は生き延びている。
　ならやはり、幸運だったと言わねばならないだろう。

　懸念があるとすれば、ここにあの警官や、あの巡察
官などが踏み込んできた場合のことだが……
　その場合も何とかなるだろうと、筋者雪車町一蔵は
踏んでいる。

　何しろこの家には無力な子供が二人もいるのだ。
　取り押さえられる前にその片方でも人質にできれば、
活路は開ける。

　……こう考える時、雪車町という男の精神上に別段、
苦痛は存在しない。
　嗜虐的な喜びを覚えることもないが――いや。あの
警官やＧＨＱの女に一泡吹かせられるのなら。

　雪車町一蔵とはそういう男だ。
　卑小な人格を持ち、卑劣に生きてきた。
　それで良いと思っている。

　人を傷つけ、陥れて、小利を稼ぐことにのみ、興味
関心が向いた。そういうことにだけ知恵が回った。
　義侠だの、恩義だの、忠孝だの、そういった上等な
ものはどうしても理解できなかった。無意味だった。

　なら仕方ない、と雪車町一蔵は思うのだ。
　自分には卑小なことしかわからない。だから卑小に
生きる。
　上等な人生は、上等なことのわかる奴がやればいい。

　だから彼は躊躇わない。
　自分を助けた少女達に災いなす考えを弄ぶことにも、
そして、それを実行することにも。
　いつもの薄笑いを浮かべたまま、雪車町はやれる。

　その卑劣さは筋金入りだ。
　打撲の痛みに意識を朦朧とさせながらも、彼はその
ような考えを巡らし、戸口が開く音を聞き取った時に
は、行動に備えて隣の様子を窺った。卑劣さが違う。

　気配を殺し――今は意識が飛んでるから完璧だなど
と彼は愚昧なことをちらと考えた――息を殺し、この
部屋と隣室を隔てる障子戸の隙間へ、頭を運ぶ。
　そして、その向こうの光景を見た。

Kageaki"...Crying?"
Kageaki"Crying means what?"
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"'Such a terrible thing I have done. Against my wishes, I did it. Really, I never wanted this.' Some tears I should shed, and underneath it all, see, such a good man I am?"
Kageaki"That is the statement you want?"
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"...Bakwas band, Muramasa."
Kageaki"A good man does not kill them IN THE FIRST PLACE! First murder, then tears, then his certificate of goodness? Nothing but the ugliest hypocrisy!"
Kageaki"Killing is evil. The one doing evil is a demon. I am that demon!"
Kageaki"MAIN HOON! I AM THE DEMON!!"
Muramasa《...What I said before, I will say again.》
Muramasa《You do not need to think.》
Muramasa《You are only the wielder. My hands and feet. Muramasa's hands and feet.》
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa《Hands and feet do not have to think. Just let yourself be used. Bas.》
Muramasa《When everything is over, I will release you. Until then, keep your heart closed.》
Muramasa《No thinking. No feeling. Wait for that time...》
Kageaki"...Your pravachan is finished? Tsurugi."
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"If you are my master, then answer one thing. Why?"
Kageaki"KYUN?"
Muramasa《...This question, I remember. You have asked it before.》
Muramasa《The answer has not changed. I am a weapon. I fulfil the principle that made me. Nothing else.》
Kageaki"Principle..."
Muramasa《Meet a demon, cut the demon. Meet a Buddha, cut the Buddha.》
Muramasa《Another reason... I have none. I am not human.》
Muramasa《Tsurugi hoon. A tsurugi.》
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa《If closing your heart is also too painful, hate me. Bas, hate me. That right you have.》
Muramasa《The blade that cursed your life. From the bottom of your heart, you have the right to hate it.》
Kageaki"No such right I have."
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"Only a weapon, you said. Correct, tsurugi. Exactly correct."
Kageaki"Weapon only. Tool only. A tool has no sin. Sin it cannot carry."
Kageaki"The duty of using it, the right, the responsibility, the guilt—all mine. Mere hain. You have none. Obviously. What master hands his responsibility to his slave?"
Muramasa《...Mido.》
Kageaki"The one using the tool carries the sin. Toh the hatred also... is for that one person only."

...Down the road to the village. Report dena tha. The headman had to hear it.

Happy he would be. Little by little, the old peace would return. The peace from before the magistrate.

Quietly. Calmly. Jaise kuch hua hi nahin. As though nothing had happened, the days would go on.

Bas, ek kami. One thing missing.

That good Emishi family would not be there.

Peaceful. Happy.
One piece absent, that much only.
